## Summary

Describe the user-facing behavior and the smallest implementation that provides it.

## Verification

- [ ] `bash scripts/test.sh` passes
- [ ] App bundle/resource/signature checks pass when packaging changed
- [ ] New behavior has a regression test that failed before the implementation
- [ ] User-facing documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when needed

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No API key, token, cookie, CLI credential, raw account response, personal identifier, or unredacted screenshot is included
- [ ] New data sources document authentication, storage, timeout, caching, and failure behavior
- [ ] Logs, cache, Widget snapshots, notifications, and error messages remain sanitized

## Screenshots

Attach only cropped, metadata-free screenshots that use demo data and contain no account identity or credential fragments.
